title: Madar Core Reset capability-validation v2 public receipt and local private evidence fragments
description: The top level validates only the closed committed public v2 receipt. Private evidence is validated only by explicitly selecting a local fragment under $defs.privateEvidenceEnvelope; no private artifact is valid at the public top level.

ownerCommentObservation.$comment: Rejection fixture: the same object with author_association NONE must fail this owner-only fragment.

roleCommentObservation.$comment: Rejection fixture: deleting or renaming any exact observation field, adding any field, changing a locked author identity, or setting includes_created_edit true must fail validation or the semantic lock join.

privateEvidenceEnvelope.title: Local-only closed private evidence envelope
privateEvidenceEnvelope.description: Implementation selects this local fragment explicitly. Each artifact kind is represented by exactly one non-overlapping branch; there is no generic or catch-all private artifact.
